import pytest

from your_module import is_valid_email


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "email",
    [
        pytest.param("user@example.com", id="basic"),
        pytest.param("USER@EXAMPLE.COM", id="uppercase"),
        pytest.param("first.last@example.com", id="dot-in-local"),
        pytest.param("first_last@example.com", id="underscore-in-local"),
        pytest.param("first-last@example-domain.com", id="hyphen-in-local-and-domain"),
        pytest.param("first+tag@example.co.uk", id="plus-and-subdomain"),
        pytest.param("first%tag@sub.example.travel", id="percent-and-long-tld"),
        pytest.param("123456@numbers123.io", id="numeric-local-and-domain"),
        pytest.param("a@b.co", id="minimum-valid-shape"),
    ],
)
def test_is_valid_email_returns_true_for_valid_emails(email: str) -> None:
    assert is_valid_email(email) is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "email",
    [
        pytest.param("", id="empty-string"),
        pytest.param("plainaddress", id="missing-at"),
        pytest.param("@example.com", id="missing-local-part"),
        pytest.param("user@", id="missing-domain"),
        pytest.param("user@example", id="missing-tld"),

        pytest.param("user@example.c", id="one-character-tld"),

        pytest.param("user@example.c0m", id="digit-in-tld"),
        pytest.param("user@exa_mple.com", id="underscore-in-domain"),
        pytest.param("user name@example.com", id="space-in-local-part"),

    "email",
    [
        pytest.param(None, id="none"),
        pytest.param(123, id="integer"),

        pytest.param({}, id="dict"),
